title: Onboard Visual Toolkit: automated mask-mapping, smart-framing rules, and locale-safe imagery
creator: Ava Chen
description: Create a reusable, automated pipeline and design specification for producing brand-consistent onboarding screenshots and quickstart visuals. The toolkit must: (1) automatically apply privacy masks (faces, emails, API keys) using SVG mask layers rather than destructive pixel edits; (2) compute smart-framing rules so screenshots crop to multiple aspect ratios while preserving focal UI elements and call-to-action visibility; (3) generate locale-safe variants that remove region-specific strings or swap to neutral placeholders and adjust layout for RTL languages; (4) produce a small set of canonical outputs for marketing, docs, and in-product quickstarts with consistent color, spacing, and accessibility contrast targets. Deliverables include spec, Figma component library, export pipeline checklist, and acceptance criteria for handoff to ENG for automation and for PM for release gating.
acceptance_criteria: SVG-based privacy masks available as reusable components (face, PII, API token, email) and documented in Figma with three opacity presets
Smart-framing algorithm spec that lists focal-point detection (heuristic + optional heatmap input) and prioritized crop rules for 16:9, 4:3, 9:16, and a square thumbnail
Locale variant guidance: tokenized labels, recommended neutral placeholders per region, and layout swaps for RTL that avoid overlap with masked areas
Export checklist: naming convention, metadata embedding (locale, aspect, masking level), and automated QA hooks (contrast check, overlap ratio < 12%)
Handoff artifacts: Figma components, Confluence implementation spec, sample 40-image batch (4 locales x 4 aspect ratios x 2 masking levels + baseline) stored in Drive
Sign-off from Design Lead and Privacy Officer documented in comments
design_notes: 2025-02-16: Kickoff — aligned with PM on target locales (en-US, fr-FR, ja-JP, ar-SA) and primary channels (docs hero, in-app quickstart, marketing screenshot). Chose SVG masks to keep original assets reusable for future edits.

2025-02-20: Prototype — built Figma components for mask shapes and an overlay system. Early trade-off: fully automatic cropping sometimes obscured microcopy; decided on hybrid approach (auto framing + manual anchor hints).

2025-02-25: Accessibility review — confirmed contrast targets for overlay tints; added explicit step to run contrast analyzer during export. Recommending 4:1 minimum for masked overlays on brand backgrounds per WCAG guidance for non-text UI elements.

2025-02-27: Engineering sync — ENG requested deterministic rules for focal-point fallback. We agreed on ordering: 1) designer anchor, 2) detected focal-point centroid, 3) center-crop fallback. ENG to return an RFC for image-processing interface (ENG-4312).

2025-02-28: Privacy Officer review — requested shrink-wrap for API token masks (rounded rect with token-shaped repeater). Added metadata field in export for 'pii_level' (none|partial|full) for downstream audit logging.
2025-03-01: Current — building final Figma kit, drafting Confluence spec, preparing 40-sample export. Next: PM review and schedule engineering spike for automation before console-2025.03 cutoff.
comments: Mateo Ruiz 2025-02-20: Ran quick test on mobile crops; microcopy was cut in ~18% of samples — introducing anchor hints reduces failures to ~2%.
Priya Nambiar (Privacy Officer) 2025-02-25: Approve SVG masks approach; require export metadata pii_level and a place in audit logs. Please add a small anonymized sample set for compliance review.
Lina Park (Design Lead) 2025-02-28: Prefer neutral placeholder text over localized lorem for screenshots; ensures consistent messaging in marketing. Approve current Figma component naming convention.
Samir Qureshi (PM) 2025-03-01: Schedule engineering spike in Cycle 2025-W09 to prototype deterministic framing service. Add release gating checklist to PRD.
